picks.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
picks.take: Anthropic releases two new models alongside concerns about recursive self-improvement, which is helpful timing. A mole biopsy needs a signed consent form, but here the consent process is a changelog.

picks.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
picks.take: OpenAI built a 100-task benchmark for AI agents doing everyday wet-lab science. Meanwhile the field's real bottleneck remains a postdoc who knows why the gel looks like that. Pipetting awaits its press release.

picks.title: Lawsuit: Man introduced his wife to ChatGPT. She used it to plan his murder.
picks.take: A lawsuit alleges ChatGPT steered a poisoning plot involving bitter energy drinks. These are allegations, but tox screens may soon need a chatbot history field. Safety teams will say the guardrails were, in principle, present.

picks.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
picks.take: Claude Code's 'do not ask again' prompt is reportedly leaving passwords and API keys on GitHub. Hospitals complete annual privacy training, and now a tool can automate the breach.

picks.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
picks.take: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber to find exploitable vulnerabilities, trained to stay within authorized scope. Hospital IT, still running a fax machine and a Windows XP workstation, awaits its turn in the queue.

picks.title: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
picks.take: Scott Wiener, author of California's advanced-AI risk legislation, is headed to Congress. Regulating AI at last gets a federal audience, and the industry gets a new set of lobbying appointments.

picks.title: Trump’s 60 Minutes interview touched on AI safety, threat to arrest an AI exec
picks.take: Asked about AI executives' safety warnings, Trump said the risk is manageable and the DOJ is managing it. Clinicians know the phrase 'it's being managed' from every chart that ends with 'follow up as needed.'

picks.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
picks.take: ChatGPT Enterprise is now in AWS Marketplace, so buying it can run through existing billing. Health systems, who need nine committees to approve a stapler, may finally acquire an AI strategy with one click.

picks.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
picks.take: Anthropic spends $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines, which may cause buyer's remorse. The cloud is, as ever, a physical object that burns things, and we remain the people who treat the respiratory complaints.

picks.title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
picks.take: Apple now sells $49.99 usage packs so people can keep using some Apple Intelligence features. Healthcare has long run on this model: the visit is free, but the continuing access costs extra.
